article_name: Top BSc Anesthesia And OT Technology Colleges In Karnataka 2025
author: @Careermudhra_

content.text: BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology is an allied health professional course of a duration of 4 years. It enables a student to the practical knowledge about Anesthesia and helps them to implement it during surgery. Students who have completed their 12th and are wondering about which program to pursue can look into this allied health professional course. But choosing an appropriate college is an important task. Before diving deep, you should know that Karnataka is the hub of these professional courses and there are ample career opportunities in the hospitals and nursing homes all over the state.

Also, India’s top BSc anesthesia and OT technology colleges in Karnataka make it easy to finalise your admission decision. Here, affordability and the quality of education make these institutions the best colleges for BSc OT technology in Karnataka. In this article, we will discuss a list of top colleges, fees, facilities, and placements of BSc anesthesia colleges in Karnataka.
Are you looking for all college details? Check “ BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology Colleges in Karnataka 2025 ” to get to know about all the colleges in detail.

sections.heading: Contents
List of Top BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology Colleges in Karnataka

content.text: All over the state, a total of 169 colleges offer the BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology course. All these colleges are under the affiliation of Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences – RGUHS . This university regulates the whole admission process to this program. No NEET is required for admission. You can apply directly from the college’s website. Remember, the top BSc Anesthesia and OT colleges in Karnataka are decided from factors like their accreditation, facilities, placement, faculty, and reviews. The table below contains such a list of the best OT technology colleges in Karnataka.

sections.heading: Sapthagiri Institute of Research Center

content.text: Recognised by RGUHS, Sapthagiri Institute of Allied Health Sciences provides cutting-edge education through advanced simulation laboratories and intensive ICU training programs. The institute’s proprietary hospital facility offers students diverse surgical exposure and comprehensive practical learning opportunities, ensuring well-rounded clinical expertise development.

sections.heading: Akash Institute of Allied Health Sciences

content.text: Situated in the serene vicinity of Bangalore Airport, Akash Institute of Allied Health Sciences provides an ideal learning environment that combines tranquil campus surroundings with exceptional medical facilities. The institute ensures comprehensive student development through continuous clinical training and dedicated academic mentorship throughout the program duration.

sections.heading: A.J. Institute of Medical Sciences & Research Centre

content.text: A.J. Institute of Medical Sciences & Research Centre in Mangalore has earned recognition as a premier institution for Anesthesia and OT technology education. This operates under Laxmi Memorial Trust(R). The institute features state-of-the-art infrastructure and advanced laboratories that meet the highest educational standards.

sections.heading: BGS Global Institute of Allied Health Sciences

content.text: BGS Global Institute of Allied Health Sciences delivers comprehensive paramedical education. It features specialised BSc programs in OT and Anesthesia technology. The institute provides students with extensive clinical training through strategic partnerships with affiliated hospitals.

sections.heading: Rajarajeshwari Institute of Allied Health Sciences

content.text: Operating under the prestigious Rajarajeshwari Medical College umbrella, Rajarajeshwari Institute of Allied Health Sciences delivers BSc Anesthesia and OT programs featuring robust hospital-integrated internships. Students benefit from expert faculty guidance and extensive clinical exposure through the institution’s high-volume patient care facility, ensuring comprehensive professional preparation.

sections.heading: BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology Fees in Karnataka

content.text: Colleges of Karnataka take the fees for the BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology program ranging from INR 2 lacs to INR 8 lacs in total. While different colleges charge different fees for this course, we have to consider the cost of studying BSc anesthesia in Karnataka before choosing the best one among them for admission. There are both expensive and moderately affordable colleges in Karnataka. Also, for students, government scholarships and loans are available in Karnataka. sections.heading: BSc Anesthesia and OT Government Colleges in Karnataka

content.text: There are a total of 16 government colleges for BSc OT in Karnataka. These colleges have competitively lower fees compared to the private institutions that offer this program. While the private ones take direct admission, all the admissions to government colleges are conducted through the CET or state-level entrance exams. The competition to get enrolled on these colleges is quite high. The following table shares BSc anesthesia government college fees in Karnataka along with the college names.

sections.heading: Hostel and Other Fees

content.text: Before taking admission, the first thing that comes to a student’s mind is the availability of accommodation facilities at a college. All the colleges in Karnataka have attached hostels for both boys and girls. Single rooms or shared room facilities are also available at some colleges. They have to bear separate fees that should be paid at the time of admission to avail the chance to get a hostel. Other facilities include all other commodities like food, Wi-Fi, mess, and security.

These fees are also to be paid along with the course fees. The average BSc anesthesia and OT hostel fees in Karnataka range from INR 30k to INR 50k annually. These fees are to be paid along with the total course fees of BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology.

sections.heading: Career Scope After BSc Anesthesia and OT

content.text: There is ample Career Scope after BSc OT in Karnataka. The graduates get exposure to become professionals through their practical knowledge of anesthesia and surgical OT Technology. The field of potential opportunities is broad. Here, plenty of employment in private and government sectors is available with specialised units like cardiac surgery or pain management. Even in teaching or with medical equipment companies, job posts are available for this course’s passouts.

Various job roles like OT Technician, Anesthesia Technician, Surgical Assistant and Critical Care Technician are available at multiple Hospitals, Clinics, and Diagnostic Centers around Karnataka. They can expect a salary range of INR 3 lakhs to 12.5 lakhs annually, depending on experience and role of BSc anesthesia salary and jobs in India. Also, students can pursue higher studies after the completion of this degree. MSc, PG diploma options are there for them. The colleges of Karnataka also provide these degree programs.
